about: Shared vectors of the Sign on phone protocol (docs/qr-signing-spec.md 8.4). One file, three runners: electron/signSessionCore.cjs (vitest), backend/lib/signSessions.js (node --test) and src-tauri/src/sign.rs (cargo test). Flows: each step runs at `at` ms on a fake clock (default: the previous step's time), as `owner` (default "local") from `ip` (default "192.0.2.1"); $token / $watch name the last start, $token:<save> a saved one; `expect` lists the status, body.code, body.state, other body keys to compare, `has` / `lacks` body keys and `retryAfter` (a Retry-After header). Caps: LAN defaults with the flow's `caps` over them; `waitMs` is the long-poll hold.
